method: Same-fixture retrospective research on actual Crown quote and settlement receipts, with model-class M9 bivariate grids fitted on latest snapshot historical cache filtered by kickoff before earliest quote receipt in each league; true previous-year prior-model forecast residual, full score-grid exp(0.1*residual*score-difference) correction. Does not reproduce production M9 exact original predictions or prove as-of historical availability.
limitations: Historical training cache is latest snapshot, filtered by kickoff only; NOT a point-in-time as-of model input archive.
Original baseline refit once per league at earliest quote receipt; not exact production per-run M9 grid, so baseline side may differ from actual production.
Actual Crown quote and settlement are verified by R55; challenger decision is retrospective, not a live pre-registered shadow.
Small sample from three leagues; no inference of long-term ROI.
No Telegram send or formal ledger change.
